rows.title: Portable delivery artifact
rows.text: The shipped archive contains its complete execution payload and passes a network-isolated launch probe.

rows.title: Command consent renewal
rows.text: Request a new explicit confirmation for the new attempt; a cancelled prompt conveys no authority to later runs.

rows.title: Search snapshot replacement
rows.text: Build a new index generation from the changed source and atomically publish it only after integrity checks succeed.

rows.title: Origin freshness check
rows.text: Before relying on remembered material, load the authoritative origin again and reject it if scope, revision, or availability changed.

rows.title: Sporadic CI investigation
rows.text: Run the suspect path under repeated controlled conditions and separate timing contamination from a stable regression.

rows.title: Semantic rollout kill switch
rows.text: A runtime switch leaves the established keyword retriever intact and disables the experimental semantic path without migration.

rows.title: 离线交付校验
rows.text: 客户可在随包提供的本地清单中核对构建摘要，无需访问外部服务。

rows.title: 跨会话偏好规则
rows.text: 只有用户主动声明需要保留的信息才能跨会话保存，并提供删除入口。

rows.title: Subscription resume cursor
rows.text: Reconnect using the highest durably processed sequence and make downstream effects idempotent.

rows.title: Reversible disk reclamation
rows.text: Inventory exact paths and sizes, then quarantine selected artifacts before any irreversible removal.

rows.title: Atomic database transition
rows.text: Construct and validate the replacement database separately, then perform one atomic cutover with the prior image retained.

rows.title: Regional clock semantics
rows.text: Store the IANA zone and intended civil time rather than a one-time numeric UTC offset.

rows.title: 副作用事件链
rows.text: 将用户确认、规范化参数、执行标识和最终状态串成可验证的事件序列。

rows.title: Durable terminal handoff
rows.text: Reload the latest persisted task state and compare live effects before continuing from the next pending step.

rows.title: Package graph pinning
rows.text: Pin the resolver version and lock graph, then verify downloaded package bytes against recorded digests.

rows.title: Durable continuation token
rows.text: Continue after the most recent acknowledged effect and reconcile any uncertain operation before issuing another.
